answer: Attestation-depth scoring at the kernel: each identity's weight equals its shortest verified trust path to a seed auditor. The walnut check requires three independent in-person attestations before weight accrues. Farming N sybils costs N attestation events plus collusion exposure; the pearl of honest edges stays rare, so fake clusters score near zero. Depth caps mean a $50k farm of 200 identities yields less voting weight than one audited node. Conclusion: forgery cost scales with real social edges, not cheap key generation.
